description: This source file defines the class 'ExpandableListItem', a model used to represent items in an expandable list within an Android application. It contains properties such as title, text, image resource, expansion state, and height measurements, as well as methods to manipulate and access these properties. It implements the 'OnSizeChangedListener' interface to update the height when the size changes.

classes.name: ExpandableListItem
classes.description: A class representing an item in an expandable list, holding its display data, state (expanded/collapsed), and height measurements, with methods to manage these properties.

methods.name: ExpandableListItem
methods.description: Constructor to initialize an expandable list item with title, image resource, collapsed height, and text.

methods.name: isExpanded
methods.description: Returns whether the list item is currently expanded.

methods.name: setExpanded
methods.description: Sets the expansion state of the list item.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the list item.

methods.name: getImgResource
methods.description: Returns the image resource ID associated with the list item.

methods.name: getCollapsedHeight
methods.description: Returns the height when the list item is collapsed.

methods.name: setCollapsedHeight
methods.description: Sets the collapsed height of the list item.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the additional text associated with the list item.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the additional text of the list item.

methods.name: getExpandedHeight
methods.description: Returns the height when the list item is expanded.

methods.name: setExpandedHeight
methods.description: Sets the expanded height of the list item.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Callback method invoked when the size of the list item changes; updates the expanded height.
